source: Apply extraction items from x18n\_extract\_plan: adds the messages to the source locale and rewrites the code. Fails when a file changed since the plan was made; plan again then.
text: 应用来自 x18n\_extract\_plan 的提取条目：将消息添加到源语言，并改写代码。如果自生成计划以来有文件发生了变化，则会失败；此时请重新生成计划。
